base64: real secrets (single-line, wrapped-76, extra newlines) identical; differences only on invalid input: uutils more lenient (CRLF, unpadded->GNU 9.7 too) or writes no partial bytes where GNU 9.4 also exits 1
cut: all sampled contexts cut ASCII git SHAs (identical); differs only on non-ASCII (uutils counts characters, GNU bytes)
date: divergence came from the 'd1' expansion placeholder; 20 realistic -d strings x 3 formats identical (60/60)
install: as root (sudo, as in the workflows) identical rc/mode/owner
nproc: differs only under a cgroup CPU quota (docker --cpus): uutils reports the quota, GNU 9.4/9.7 the affinity count; identical without quota and with cpuset
